purpose: Keep hundreds of monster JSON recipes tiny while preserving reusable family DNA and reusable variant DNA.
rules: Family profile owns anatomy and behavior shared by the species/family.
Variant profile owns reusable anatomy, geometry, condition, swarm form, object form, or other identity that differs materially from the family.
Monster recipes should contain only identifiers, selected family/variant profiles, concise traits, locomotion exceptions, and truly one-off overrides.
Page recipes own scene-specific props, selected environment, exact action, support, and story interaction.
Known family and variant failure modes must be injected into generation and review.
Never copy reusable scenery into family, variant, or monster recipes.
If a distinction could apply to multiple pages or future monsters, promote it to family DNA or variant DNA instead of repeating it.
scalability_rule: Hundreds of monsters resolve through reusable family DNA and variant DNA. Individual monster recipes remain small and reusable scenery remains exclusively in the environment engine.

monster_may_define: variant-specific environment preferences when truly unique
environment_ownership.rule: If a visual element could be reused by another creature in the same place, it belongs in the universal environment engine: family/profile/component/overlay system.

variant_profile.ownership_rule: Use variant DNA for reusable differences such as undead form, swarm form, ooze geometry, disguised-object form, construct object type, detached limb, or skeletal form.
variant_profile.family_lock: A variant profile must declare the same family_profile as the monster recipe that references it.
